code_name: Uneven impact across architectural work
rationale: Architecture knowledge is valued not only as documentation for people but as context, constraints and checkable intent for agents; making it explicit does not ensure that it is complete, usable or reliably applied.

code_name: Continuity of architectural purpose and method
